    print(label, B.shape[1], '%.3e'%(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt)))

names+=['exp(-P)','P*exp(-P)','P1.5*exp(-P)']
B=np.c_[tuple(feats)]
c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
for n,v in zip(names,c):
    if abs(v)>1e-3: print(n, round(v,4))
